name: The Wolf Man
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets (the Horseman's style). Transylvania's seat 3, drawn facing right and mirrored. The master is the rest pose's OWN head. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. No prop: his ears and claws are the tell surface.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, ears up
what.A3: Check: one clawed finger taps the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a gruff push of the hand toward the middle
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both fists raised, a joyful howl (`win_big`)
what.B4: Sniffs at the pot, muzzle stretched toward the middle
what.B5: Growls at a draught (decoy for B4)
what.C1: Scratches behind one ear (decoy for B6)
what.C3: Sheds on the tablecloth, brushing the fur away (decoy for C2)
what.C4: Glances at the window and the moon
what.C5: Looks at the viewer, ears pricked, a little sheepish
what.C6: Ears swivel back toward a sound behind him
what.D1: Talking: one clawed hand raised, apologetic
what.D2: Facing a big bet: hackles up, eyes narrowed
what.D3: Lost a pot: ears down, a low whine
what.D4: Crushing loss: ears flat, head hung low, a long whine (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms, teeth showing
what.D6: A rough laugh, half a bark

rest.what: his right forearm and clawed hand
his left forearm and clawed hand
